# introduction
Read the guidelines at .github/copilot-instructions. You have the role of reviewer, you will write plans for analyzer and then start an analyzer subagent to carry out that those plans. It is up to you how to schedule and send off the tasks to analyzer subagent(s), but keep the work of each subagent isolated. Be careful of recompiling executables which might be in use by another program. If there is a chance a file is being edited or executable ran or will soon-to-be ran by anther subagent, then wait until that subagent's task has concluded. For analysis production use 20-30 threads, for skimming use 5 threads for mc and 10 threads for data.

# pPb and Pbp data discrepancy followup
## partition Pbp into two parts based on run number
Use MainAnalysis/20260414_pPbPbpCombining as a working directory. The list of observables to track in the pPb and Pbp workflow to the following list.
 - trk eta
 - trk pt
 - Z y
 - Z pt
 - event multiplicity
 - Z-track (delta eta, delta phi) ratio map
 - Z-track delta eta correlation
 - Z-track delta phi correlation

And for each of these include 6 levels of corrections as done before:
For six levels of corrections: 
 - no corrections, no EventWeight, no TrackWeight
 - only VZ correction
 - VZ correction + Z correction
 - VZ correction + Z correction + Z scale factor
 - VZ correction + Z correction + Z scale factor + TrackWeight
 - VZ correction + Z correction + Z scale factor + TrackWeight + TrackResidual

Look through the pPb data skim and determine if the runs are ordered in strictly increasing order. Determine an run number which partitions the number of pPb roughly in half, with all run with run below this number equal in number to those above.

Make two new presentations with the following conditions:
 - keep Pbp at full statistics. But for the pPb set, select only the first half of runs in the skim. Note the run numbers in the metadata slide. Make a full presentation with all the plots listed above but use this partition of the pPb set.
 - keep Pbp at full statistics and use the second half of runs in the skim.

Use Z pt 0-500 and trk pt 0.5-15 as kinematic selection. No need to calculate the Z data correction for these. Compute each of these histograms for all 6 levels of corrections AND for nominal pile up and PU reject cases. Keep the plotting and analysis contained to the sandbox and do not override anything in the official weight dictionary. 

# conclusion
Make the minimum number of edits necessary to implement functionality. Do not add superflous error statement catches or checks. 

Have the subanalyzer handoff a summary to you and you should review that summary for flaws. Update copilot instructions on the new norms detailed here and learned by you or the subanalyzer throught these tasks.
